summary: Practise BATNA planning, conflict diagnosis and agreement follow-through in a five-day course. Explore the outline and see if it fits your role.
lede: Workplace negotiation and conflict management help professionals clarify interests, assess alternatives and reach workable agreements. For project managers, HR and employee-relations professionals, the course uses practical workplace cases to develop conflict diagnosis with the Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument, BATNA and ZOPA analysis for preparation, and clear agreement records with owners and due dates.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who negotiate terms, resolve workplace disagreements or need to turn verbal agreements into clear commitments.
prerequisites: Prior involvement in workplace discussions, negotiations or conflict resolution is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
